description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Pave Finance is a wealth management technology company that uses machine learning to help financial advisers build personalized investment strategies and automate trading. The Software Engineer 1 will develop and maintain software, manage project deliverables, and contribute across the technology stack while using AI coding tools and supporting internal team scalability.
Software engineer building, testing, deploying, and maintaining software products

Responsibilities:
• Design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and improve software
• Manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables
• Take on tasks as requested and follow through to completion despite roadblocks or distractions

Requirements:
• 0 - 2 + years of professional experience in software engineering or site reliability engineering
• General understanding of code, structures, and algorithms
• Ability to learn other coding languages as needed
• Comfortable contributing across the stack (TypeScript, React and SQL databases)
• Proficient in using AI coding tools

Preferred:
• a BSc in Software Engineering or Computer Science or higher degree
• Collaboration abilities in cross-functional startup environments and strong technical communication skills
• Default to automating and abstracting painful manual workflows
• Enjoy writing clean code, thinking about system design, and scaling both systems and developer productivity
• Are proactive, low-ego, and comfortable owning projects end-to-end
